notes.title: Online multiplayer comes to THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition in Update 3
notes.content:
The third update of THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition introduces two exciting new features and a host of bug fixes.

Update 3 allows you to play THE GAME OF LIFE in a whole new way; via online multiplayer. Match with other players or invite your Steam friends to play against you as you race to the final yellow square.

Here’s a breakdown of the new features included in Update 3:

    Online multiplayer
    Invite Steam friends to play online
    Bug fixes

As always we are committed to making THE GAME OF LIFE the very best board game adaptation available on Steam, and now, with this update, you’ll be able to spin the wheel and enjoy this constantly improving game with more people than ever before.

More updates are in the works so please continue to let us know what you would like to see in THE GAME OF LIFE and we’ll try our best to include the best suggestions.

Dean Samways 
Community Manager 
Marmalade Technologies

notes.title: THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition gets Update 2!
notes.content:
THE GAME OF LIFE is receiving its second update in under a week as Marmalade Game Studio works tirelessly to give you the best game possible.

Update 2 introduces:

    Steam Trading Cards
    Ten fun Achievements
    Five backgrounds to spruce up your Steam Profile
 
We’re committed to continually improve THE GAME OF LIFE so you can continue to enjoy it over and over again with family and friends.

Future updates will follow so please let us know what you would like to see in upcoming versions and we’ll try our best to implement what we can.

Dean Samways 
Community Manager 
Marmalade Technologies

notes.title: Update 1 for THE GAME OF LIFE - The Official 2016 Edition is here!
notes.content:
Live THE GAME OF LIFE in the all-new and improved Official 2016 Edition

Today, THE GAME OF LIFE is receiving a brand new update. Enjoy the very best playing experience on your path to success, becoming graduates, parents and millionaires along the way.

With its new modern aesthetic, simpler menu navigation and two brand new mini-games, THE GAME OF LIFE has never looked or played better. Download the latest version from Steam now to enjoy these, and the following, new features.

Update 1 also includes:

    ‘Grab the Cash’ and ‘Statues’ mini-games
    New Player Selection Menu
    Enhanced user interface 
    New keyboard controls - Press Space to spin the wheel!
    Improved tutorials and feedback text

Progressing through THE GAME OF LIFE, one tile, one milestone at a time, has never been more fun!

Download the latest version of THE GAME OF LIFE from Steam here.

Let us know what you think of the improvements, but for now, spin the wheel and win big at THE GAME OF LIFE!

Dean Samways 
Community Manager 
Marmalade Technologies

notes.title: Game Of Life Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello Game of Life players,

We want to take this opportunity to thank you all for your patience as we update The Game of Life - Official 2016 Edition.

Your comments and feedback are being heard and improvements implemented in the ongoing game development pipeline. Your continued input and our ongoing work will deliver the best Game of Life experience possible on Steam in the very near future.

Please keep sending us your thoughts via the discussion boards and we will continue to listen.

We’re planning to release an updated version of Game of Life very soon and of course our Steam community will be the first to know when that lands.

Until then, please continue to enjoy The Game of Life - Official 2016 Edition and keep your comments coming.

Dean Samways
Community Manager
Marmalade Technologies
